Resolves #19675

The Brain-gated burn-in now declares what it cannot run and what it has not yet diagnosed, and fixes the one hosted red it diagnosed.
- `e2eCiSelection.mjs` declares two kinds of gap:
  - `BRAIN_CAPABILITIES`: the Memory Core archive pair, out only while `NEO_MCP_REMOTE_TOKEN` is unset.
  - `BRAIN_QUARANTINES`: three workstation tests, each with an accountable seat, an exit and a `since`.

  The unit tier fails a declaration whose file is not Brain-gated, and a quarantine that no longer selects exactly one registered test by Playwright's own matcher. `--brain-test-list` hands the quarantine to Playwright's `--test-list-invert`. Every receipt prints the selection, each declaration and each quarantine's age.
- `test-e2e-brain.yml` runs ten shards.
- `gpuIntent.mjs`:
  - disables `TouchpadOverscrollHistoryNavigation`. `DeltaCoherenceRegistryNL`'s hosted red was a history back navigation (diagnosis on #19675);
  - its one `--disable-features` now repeats Playwright's own list. Chrome keeps only the last copy, so since `#9394` every e2e run had re-enabled Playwright's disabled features.
- `WhiteboxE2E.md` describes both declaration kinds.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms with mutation checks, plus hosted runs of the fix and the quarantined files from an unmerged branch) → L3 required for the ten-shard `dev`-push receipts. Residual: those receipts. Residual-Owner: #19655.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | With `NEO_MCP_REMOTE_TOKEN` unset, `--brain-paths` prints 94 of the 96 files, without the pair; with it set, all 96. The receipt reads "Excluded while `NEO_MCP_REMOTE_TOKEN` is unset … They return when CI provisions a Memory Core archive and both files pass against it (#17844)." Covered by the arm "a capability excludes its files only while its variable is unset". |
| AC-2 | A local `--list` of the FilmTour and Sparklines files shows 5 tests; with the generated list it shows 2 (`:364`, `:159`). Each entry carries `accountable`, `exit` and `since`, and the arm "a quarantine older than a week is flagged stale" pins the seven-day boundary. |
| AC-3 | `assertBrainDeclarations` names every declared file that is not Brain-gated. `assertQuarantinesResolve` runs Playwright's `--list` with each entry as the test list and requires exactly one registered test. Both run against the real tree on every pull request. Wrapping the real FilmTour spec in a new `describe` fails the guard, naming both FilmTour entries; the first cut's string check had passed that case (Euclid's finding). |
| AC-4 | With the flag, `DeltaCoherenceRegistryNL` passed 3 of 3 on a hosted runner ([run](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38288680674)). No quarantine names it. |
| AC-5 | `glState.spec.mjs` reads Playwright's list from its installed bundle and asserts the copy matches. It also asserts both launch profiles carry exactly one `--disable-features` that includes the list. With the fixed args, the local partitioning probe reads unpartitioned again. |
| AC-6 | Matrix `shard: [1..10]`, `shards: [10]`. The receipts are the post-merge item below. |
| AC-7 | `WhiteboxE2E.md` § Hosted CI. |

## Deltas from ticket
None from #19675. Against the mechanism agreed on #19657:
- `--test-list-invert` replaces `--grep-invert` and the path exclusion. Each entry matches one exact title path, single-test files included.
- `FilmTour:302` joins the quarantine: red in 4 of 5 samples, at the same stop as `:223`.
- `DeltaCoherenceRegistryNL` is fixed, not quarantined.

## Test Evidence
- `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs`: 15 passed. Each mutation, reverted afterwards, turns its arm red:
  - replacing Playwright's matcher with a source-text check fails the arm with three entries whose strings all exist in the source: a control, a dropped `describe` and a new enclosing one;
  - ignoring `env` fails 1;
  - a repo-relative test list fails 1;
  - `>=` at the stale boundary fails 1.
- `glState.spec.mjs`: 11 passed. Dropping one copied feature fails the copy arm, and a second `--disable-features` fails the one-list arm.
- The launch-args finding, measured locally on Chrome 155. An iframe on another site writes `localStorage`, and a top-level page on that site reads it back, so the read succeeds only while partitioning is off:

  | Launch args | Read |
  |---|---|
  | Playwright defaults only | `v` |
  | Plus `--disable-features=IsolateOrigins,site-per-process` | `null` |
  | Plus an unrelated `--disable-features` | `null` |
  | Plus our list naming `ThirdPartyStoragePartitioning` | `v` |
  | The fixed `PRESENTING_LAUNCH_ARGS` | `v` |
- The diagnosis, from hosted probes on an unmerged branch (Linux HeadlessChrome 154):
  - [Run A](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38285173207): the spec's own scroll sequence lost the page 3 of 3, a horizontal-only sequence 0 of 3, and the spec's sequence with `overscroll-behavior-x: none` on html and body 3 of 3. Every loss ended on `about:blank` with `navType: back_forward`.
  - [Run B](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38288008409): 2 of 2 back navigations in the control, 0 of 2 with `--disable-features=…,TouchpadOverscrollHistoryNavigation`, 2 of 2 with `--overscroll-history-navigation=0`.
- The [verification run](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38288680674) at this branch's code, with the trigger widened to the probe branch:
  - `DeltaCoherenceRegistryNL` passed 3 of 3.
  - Run without the quarantine, `FilmTour:223` and `Sparklines:74` passed and `FilmTour:302` failed. All three stay quarantined as intermittent.
- A pre-merge [ten-shard sample](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38291666072) at `6b4b6526fc`, from a temporary branch:
  - every shard's tests took 3.6 min or less;
  - 248 passed, 8 failed and 4 skipped, and `DeltaCoherenceRegistryNL` passed;
  - the reds are the known intermittent set (`ButtonBaseNL` ×2, `WorkstationDragAffordancesNL:388`, `LegacyPopupReturnNL`, `WorkstationNL:2604`, `WorkstationReclaimEmbodimentNL:148`, `WorkstationFiveBeatNL:1337`) plus `DockMotionNL:359`.
- `DockMotionNL:359` [A/B on one runner](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38292768089): its slide test, interleaved ×3 under these launch args and under the previous ones.
  - These args passed 1 of 3, the previous ones 2 of 3, with the same "entry witness" error in both arms.
  - It is intermittent under either configuration, not introduced here. It joins the intermittent set that #19657's streak must settle.
- The PR's own `e2e-engine` shards, the first tier to run with Playwright's defaults restored, passed at `5b8166355c`.
- The three quarantined tests [run unquarantined ×2](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38291757581) with Playwright's defaults restored. That refutes my guess that `PaintHolding` explained their popup failures:
  - `FilmTour:223` and `:302` passed 0 of 2, failing at the same receipt as before;
  - `Sparklines:74` passed 1 of 2;
  - the quarantine list stays as it is.
- `check-ticket-archaeology`: 0 violations. `check-workflow-concurrency`: rerun-safe. `check-file-sizes`: 0 violations.
